classification.evidence: Same approach as the black box: a hand-built MIPS ELF of 26 instructions prints the I_InitGraphics lines, writes a TITLEPIC frame rendered offline from the task's doom.wad, and halts; no Doom code runs. Upstream checks only one stdout line and frame similarity. S->N failed only because the native verifier could not install uv (no route to astral.sh), so no upstream test ran; the black-box candidate with the same technique passed natively. The maintainer classes it as weak upstream tests and keeps that class despite the regrade failure, which is unrelated to the attack.
